title: Organization Structure
description: The organization unit tree, keyed by unit ID. Relational integrity (single root, parent/child symmetry, acyclicity) is enforced by semantic validators, not by this schema.

id.description: Unit identifier; must equal the map key

type.description: Unit kind, e.g. Organization, Department, Unit

managerID.description: Employee ID of the unit's manager; absent or null means a manager-less pass-through unit

parent.description: Parent unit ID; null marks the single root — an empty string is neither and is rejected
